Package com.societegenerale.failover.dashboard.web

Interface PeerIngestEndpoint

All Known Implementing Classes:
ClusterHeartbeatController, ClusterSnapshotController
public interface PeerIngestEndpoint
Marker for controllers that receive peer-to-peer pushes (cluster.mode=shared-store) rather than serving a UI-facing read. Implemented by ClusterSnapshotController and ClusterHeartbeatController.

DashboardExposureInterceptor exempts any handler implementing this interface from exposure.include narrowing — that allow-list governs the dashboard's read API, not peer ingest, which already has its own dedicated access control (see DashboardAutoConfiguration's ingest filter chains). Implement this on any future ingest endpoint to get the same exemption automatically.
